targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(aw*hrs)/1000.0,0) AS "Total kWh" FROM (
 SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(device_name,''), device_id) dev, avg(watts) aw, GREATEST(extract(epoch from(max(ts)-min(ts)))/3600.0,0.001) hrs
 FROM telemetry.energy WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (device_id LIKE 'eve:%' OR (device_name IS NOT NULL AND device_name NOT LIKE '0x%')) GROUP BY dev) s

SELECT round((SUM(w)/1000.0)::numeric,2) AS "kW now" FROM (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(NULLIF(device_name,''), device_id)) watts w FROM telemetry.energy WHERE ts>now()-interval '10 min' AND (device_id LIKE 'eve:%' OR (device_name IS NOT NULL AND device_name NOT LIKE '0x%')) ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(device_name,''), device_id), ts DESC) s

SELECT round((LEAST(k,300)*0.18 + GREATEST(k-300,0)*0.2782)::numeric,2) AS "Proj $/mo" FROM (
 SELECT (SUM(w)/1000.0)*730 AS k FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(NULLIF(device_name,''), device_id)) watts w FROM telemetry.energy WHERE ts>now()-interval '10 min' AND (device_id LIKE 'eve:%' OR (device_name IS NOT NULL AND device_name NOT LIKE '0x%')) ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(device_name,''), device_id), ts DESC) x) y

SELECT count(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(device_name,''), device_id)) AS "Devices" FROM telemetry.energy WHERE ts>now()-interval '10 min' AND (device_id LIKE 'eve:%' OR (device_name IS NOT NULL AND device_name NOT LIKE '0x%'))

SELECT time, metric, SUM(aw)/1000.0 AS "kWh" FROM (
 SELECT $__timeGroup(ts,'1h') AS time, CASE WHEN device_id LIKE 'eve:%' THEN 'Eve strips' ELSE 'Zigbee plugs' END AS metric, COALESCE(NULLIF(device_name,''), device_id) AS dev, avg(watts) aw
 FROM telemetry.energy WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (device_id LIKE 'eve:%' OR (device_name IS NOT NULL AND device_name NOT LIKE '0x%')) GROUP BY 1,2,3) s GROUP BY time,metric ORDER BY time

panels.title: kWh per hour — stacked by source

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, SUM(aw)/1000.0 AS "Total kW" FROM (
 SELECT $__timeGroup(ts,'5m') AS time, COALESCE(NULLIF(device_name,''), device_id) dev, avg(watts) aw FROM telemetry.energy
 WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (device_id LIKE 'eve:%' OR (device_name IS NOT NULL AND device_name NOT LIKE '0x%')) GROUP BY 1,2) s GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(device_name,''), device_id) AS "Device", CASE WHEN device_id LIKE 'eve:%' THEN 'Eve strips' ELSE 'Zigbee plugs' END AS "Source",
 round((avg(watts)*GREATEST(extract(epoch from(max(ts)-min(ts)))/3600.0,0.001)/1000.0)::numeric,3) AS "kWh (period)",
 round(avg(watts)) AS "Avg W" FROM telemetry.energy WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (device_id LIKE 'eve:%' OR (device_name IS NOT NULL AND device_name NOT LIKE '0x%')) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 25
